description: Gets showtimes for a date (today in Caracas by default). Cinepic requires cinema_id (123300 Candelaria or 123301 VVIP Lido); Cines Unidos requires city; Cinex accepts city for all its verified venues in the city in one call, cinema_id for one venue (with optional movie_id to filter), or only movie_id to read the movie's page across all venues; Supercines accepts cinema_id, city or movie_id; Gran Cine (arthouse cinema, includes the Paseo Las Mercedes theaters) accepts cinema_id, city or neither for all its theaters, without provider showtime IDs; use query to filter by title. The venue call resolves titles against the catalog and marks partial when it cannot confirm a movie_id. Returns the IDs needed for prices, screen/format when available and the website URL.

cinema_id.description: Venue ID returned by list_cinemas for the same provider. Do not mix IDs across providers. If the venue includes code_status, use cinema_id only when it is verified; directory-* IDs cannot be queried.

city.description: City name as returned by list_cities for the same provider (e.g. Caracas); accents and case are ignored for Cines Unidos.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD; defaults to today in America/Caracas for Cinepic/Cines Unidos movies and showtimes and for Cinex, Supercines and Gran Cine showtimes.

movie_id.description: Movie ID returned by list_movies for the same provider; optional for Cinex when querying a whole venue.

provider.description: Cinema provider; get its capabilities and limitations with list_providers.

query.description: Filters by name, ignoring accents and case.

refresh.description: true: queries the provider without the local cache and requests HTTP revalidation. Does not guarantee that the provider has updated its content.

name: get_showtimes

cinema_name.description: Venue name when the source publishes it with the showtime.

date.description: Business date of the showtime in America/Caracas (YYYY-MM-DD).

id.description: Showtime identifier; use it as session_id when looking up prices.

language.description: Version: es or en (dubbed) and subtitulada at Cinex and Cines Unidos (which also marks it in the title, (Esp) or (Sub)); subtitulada or no_subtitulada at Cinepic. Absent when not confirmed.

movie_id.description: Movie ID confirmed by list_movies or by the Cinex catalog when querying a whole venue.

rating.description: Age rating the provider publishes (A, B, C; Cines Unidos may vary it by venue, such as B+12).

screen.description: Room as the provider names it (3, VIP, VIP (Piso 5), 4DX).

starts_at.description: Timestamp with time zone; may be missing for late-night showtimes.

title: Get showtimes
